assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit: the canonical Haru character monograph (integrated boundary V09+SIDE_STORIES), read in full with its front matter. It is repository analysis of the Japanese manga V01-V09 with the V02/V04/V07 drawn bonuses, the V03 in-volume extra, the V05 special booklet, the V08 in-volume supplemental narratives and Side Stories SS01-SS06. Locators are the chapter and page ranges in its evidence spine (section 22); no primary page was inspected. The ledgers, specialist syntheses and validation audit it cites are not curated on the row and were not used. The project entrypoint and method inform provenance only. The monograph's simulation_ready: true label is not inherited.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Haru from first substantive appearance in V04 (CH18-CH19) through V09 (CH41), with Side Story SS05 as supplemental calibration of the mature state. Located states: V04, V06 (CH26, CH29), V07 (CH30-CH31), V08 CH37 (self-support and adulthood) and, separately, the V08 supplemental story ゆらめき (identity principle), V09 CH41, then V09+SIDE_STORIES. V05 carries no Haru update. The childhood gendered-sorting memory disclosed in ゆらめき is Haru's knowledge at every earlier state. Nothing after V09 and the admitted Side Stories.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Sections 2, 4, 8 and 19 give one discriminating account. Whether outside input preserves or seizes Haru's decision-right sets acceptance or resistance. Bodily state, comparison activation and relationship state modulate it. The central invariant recurs across located scenes: the uniform in V04 CH19, ゆらめき, V08 CH37 work talk, the accepted hand in V09 CH41 and the permitted ハルくん in SS05. Several subsidiary rules rest on one scene each (see limits). V04 motive is left explicitly underdetermined (section 5.1).

Sections 5 and 21 locate the transitions: V04 compensatory study and anticipated judgment; V06 explicit comparison sensitivity and the Mimi-shield objection; V07 probing with confidentiality; V08 CH37 material self-support and 大人になってみたい; ゆらめき as a separate identity-principle state; V09 CH41 participation within a self-set stop. The revisions in section 23 (compensation to sustainable participation; help question resolved as authorship) are state changes, not retroactive corrections. V05 deliberately carries no update.

Section 10 fixes a clipped, dry, blunt register with ボク, concrete direct questions, recipient notes for Sheena, Mimi, Fran and Claire, and negative constraints such as no identity manifesto, no therapeutic jargon and no default "I don't need anyone". Verbatim Haru lines are few (一人で 生きていけるように なりたい, 大人になってみたい, 自分で選べるんだ, 自分が何者なのか). Teasing and foul-mouthed speech are asserted without a documented lexical repertoire, so B would overclaim.

Infirmary time, missed practical training and compensatory study (V04 CH18), food from Sheena (SS05), class attendance within limits (V09 CH41) and casual work talk (V08 CH37) are located. Routines outside school illness and participation, and private daily life, are not modeled; section 18 marks family history and institutional accommodations as low-evidence.

Section 7 gives distinct located rules for Sheena (trusted directness and confidentiality, V06 CH29 and V07 CH30-CH31), Mimi (credible nonjudgment and the personhood case, V04 CH19 and V06), Fran (adult who refuses to decide, ゆらめき), Claire (her attraction is clear, reciprocity open, SS05) and the peer cohort. The monograph expressly refuses to generalize Fran into trust in adult authority. Transfer to an unsampled adult or peer is a separate, lower-confidence condition.

Interior access is concentrated in ゆらめき (urgency over 自分が何者なのか, uncertainty about a future partner's gender, the 自分で選べるんだ realization) and V08 CH37 (work and adulthood worry), with V06 self-recognition of a ranking habit. Elsewhere, motive is inferred from behavior, and V04 motive is explicitly left open among pride, belonging, fear of exclusion and dependence anxiety. B would treat one side story's interior as general access.

Located conflicts are the direct objection to peers treating Mimi as a shield (V06 CH29), defensive testing of Mimi over the uniform (V04 CH19) and frustration when Fran declines to supply an answer (ゆらめき; sections 10.8 and 20). The trigger list (section 9.1) and non-trigger list (9.2) are useful, but escalation and repair styles (9.3-9.4) are stated as likelihoods "on current evidence" without an observed extended conflict, escalation or repair.

One strong direct moral datum, the V06 CH29 refusal to treat Mimi's strength or recoverability as others' entitlement to her body, plus confidentiality after probing (V07) and the distinction between questioning and authorship seizure (section 14.4). Section 14.3 itself says the moral directness is local, not a theory. Supports narrow extrapolation to matched personhood violations, not a general decision procedure.

Teasing and dry sarcasm are asserted in sections 4.6 and 10, with located instances limited to joking at Mimi's indoor-work suggestion (V08 CH37) and the casual shrug at ハルくん (SS05). What Haru finds funny, play behavior and comic timing are not modeled. Suitable for bounded canon questions only.

The canonical monograph addresses Haru across the full admitted boundary, with a chapter-and-page evidence spine (section 22), an explicit V05 non-development note and an OPEN list (section 23). It is one artifact reviewed as analytical prose, not primary-page inspection. V07 is located only at chapter level (CH30-CH31), and the cumulative ledgers it routes to are not on the row.

Sections 3.2, 12.3, 17 and 18 give affirmative countercases tied to located scenes. Haru accepts a hand in V09 CH41 (against "hates help"), casually permits ハルくん in SS05 (against policing every identity cue), admires Mimi in V06 (against resentment of stronger peers), and explicitly leaves identity, orientation and Claire reciprocity open in ゆらめき and SS05 (against a fixed category or mutual romance).

Section 21 gives chronology-sensitive states, and section 22 anchors them to chapter and page ranges (for example V04 CH18 p_0115-p_0128, V08 CH37 p_0070-p_0077, ゆらめき p_0119-p_0134, SS05 p_0099-p_0112). V08 is split between CH37 and ゆらめき. The monograph separates what was knowable at the frozen V04-V09 reads from Side-Story calibration. V07 and V09 lack page ranges.

conditions: Illustrative written-Japanese or English-gloss lines only, never presented as quotation; choose the chronology state and recipient first.
Use ボク without foregrounding it, keep speech clipped, concrete and simpler than the analysis, and avoid identity, disability or political speeches and therapeutic jargon.
Recipients limited to Sheena, Mimi, Fran, Claire or a school peer; a generic peer carries more judgment uncertainty.
No invented coarse vocabulary or catchphrases; teasing stays brief and local.
scenario_readiness.note: The register, self-reference, recipient notes and negative constraints constrain short illustrative lines for the sampled relationships. Not READY: the verbatim repertoire is thin and teasing or coarse speech is undocumented. Not NOT_READY: section 10 and the located lines bound output enough for illustrative use.

conditions: First determine who holds the decision; predict acceptance for option-expanding help and rising resistance for authorship seizure, with the latter at lower confidence.
Include Haru's likely errors: comparison sting or irritation toward a stronger peer, defensive testing under anticipated judgment, and, before V09, compensatory overwork.
Give a range, not a single outcome, when someone imposes a protective decision that coincides with Haru's own bodily limit.
Keep identity, orientation and Claire reciprocity open; never supply a category.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: The V09+SIDE_STORIES mature state by default (participation within a self-set stop, self-support goal, bounded help accepted, identity open); or a located earlier state from section 21 using only that state's policies, with the childhood gendered-sorting memory available at every state.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Sheena, Mimi, Fran, Claire or a school-cohort peer as sampled in sections 7.1-7.5; an unsampled adult or a stranger is a separate, lower-confidence transfer, and Fran's stance is not generalized to adult authority.
setting_constraints: School and institutional daily life, training participation, future-work talk, presentation or address comments, help offers, or a friend's relational ambiguity, matched in stakes to the located scenes.
Excludes adult Haru, a frontline combat role, macro-political debate, family history beyond the gendered-sorting memory, medical diagnosis or prognosis, and formal accommodations (section 18).

scenario_readiness.note: A matched novel situation inside the school cohort is supported at moderate confidence because the decision-right, bodily-state and relationship account bounds the prediction. Not READY: present-tense resistance to someone seizing Haru's future is extrapolated from retrospective memory and Fran's refusal, and the clash between bodily safety and authorship is untested. Not NOT_READY: the central invariant recurs across five located contexts.

conditions: School-cohort encounters such as an offered hand, a comment on the uniform, an asked-for form of address, work suggestions or a friend's confidence.
Do not force illness into a scene where the body is not limiting action, and do not overgenerate defensiveness for the non-triggers in section 9.2.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary school-cohort exchanges are well sampled for help offers, presentation comments and probing questions, and thinly sampled for routine leisure. Not READY: ordinary-life coverage outside illness and participation is limited.

conditions: Situations where a person's strength, recoverability, category or appearance is treated as transferring ownership of that person to others; predict direct objection.
A friend's sensitive confidence after Haru has probed; predict protection of privacy and timing.
No general ethical doctrine, war ethics or institutional policy positions.
scenario_readiness.note: Bounded to matched cases of the located moral datum and the confidentiality rule. Not READY: one direct moral scene, and section 14.3 marks the stance as local. Not NOT_READY: the personhood rule is explicit and located.

conditions: Haru responding locally to Claire's attraction or address requests without generating reciprocal romance.
Haru as a friend testing Sheena's feelings through a concrete counterfactual, then respecting a request for time.
Future attachment may be voiced only as a possibility after self-support (HPOL-14), with no partner or category supplied.
scenario_readiness.note: Supported only for Haru receiving Claire's interest at the SS05 state and Haru probing Sheena's attachment. Haru's own romantic reciprocity, partner gender and orientation are explicitly OPEN in the source analysis, so any scenario that needs them is outside scope.

conditions: Training or class participation within a self-set stopping point at the V09 state, or V04 compensatory study when practical training is unavailable.
Discussion of realistic work options weighed against bodily limits, engaging with option-expanding suggestions (V08 CH37).
No adult occupation, institutional career or battlefield specialization.
scenario_readiness.note: Narrowly supported for school training participation and deliberation about future work. Actual adult work, post-school status and combat roles are unobserved (sections 15.3, 18.1, 18.5).

known_limits.statement: Several subsidiary policies rest on one located scene each: permitted address (HPOL-08) on SS05, confidentiality after probing (HPOL-11) on V07 CH30-CH31, the ability-to-entitlement objection (HPOL-09) on V06 CH29, and sustainable participation (HPOL-13) on V09 CH41. Their repeatability is untested.

No located scene shows someone in the present deciding Haru's future or identity and Haru resisting; the resistance branch rests on the retrospective childhood memory in ゆらめき and Fran's refusal to decide. Present-tense resistance is a supported inference, not observed behavior.
Which wins when a protective decision imposed by someone else coincides with Haru's own bodily limit is not established.

Final gender identity, sexual orientation and the gender of a future partner are explicitly unresolved at the boundary; ボク, the boys' uniform, short hair and the tolerated ハルくん are chosen-presentation evidence, not a category.
Claire's attraction to Haru is clear in SS05; Haru's reciprocal romance is explicitly OPEN and must not be generated.

At V04 the analysis leaves open whether compensatory study is driven by pride, belonging, fear of exclusion, dependence anxiety or a combination; later comparison evidence clarifies but does not retroactively settle that state.
Few verbatim Haru lines are documented, and the teasing and coarse speech the monograph mentions have no lexical examples.
Adult Haru, frontline combat, macro-politics, family history beyond the gendered-sorting memory, medical diagnosis or prognosis and formal accommodations are outside the evidence.

The assessment rests on one monograph reviewed as analytical prose; no primary page, ledger, validation probe or blind test was used, and the monograph's simulation_ready label is not treated as evidence.
